messages:
Sam (growth): Quick triage  post-launch posts + webinar outreach: sessions +28% but MQLs flat. Can we check attribution + form timing before Monday KPI?
Priya: Noted. We rotated CTAs mid-stream (cta=beta vs cta=announce) and changed the tracking template. Suspect UTM fragmentation.
Diego: Also partner redirect used short param src=partnerZ, no utm_source. That will pull into referral.
Sam (growth): Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.com/s/marketing/kpi-weekly — the channel CPL looks worse than expected.
InsightBot: Quick pull: landing_template_summary:
```
hero_full: sessions=13,900 leads=400 mqls=42
compact_announce: sessions=5,200 leads=86 mqls=3
webinar_landing: sessions=2,300 leads=74 mqls=14
```
Clare: Webinar regs convert to MQL at ~19% but volume small vs launch posts. Could be LTV-positive but not moving top-line MQLs.
Priya: Action: I'll reconcile utm_source + referrer and flag utm_missing rows.
Diego: I'll map partnerZ redirect and add an alias in tracking to combine into partnerZ/utm.
Clare: I'll pull registration->mql lag by landing template; announce compact has longer time-to-mql due to nurture.
Sam (growth): Target: updates by Monday 09:00 PT. Also please add an annotation on the KPI board for the tracking/template change and partner redirect so week-over-week readers don't misinterpret.
InsightBot: Annotation created: "2026-06-11 CTA template change + partnerZ redirect may affect utm attribution and immediate raw MQL counts."
Priya: CSV of reconciled paths will be posted here when ready.
Sam (growth): Thanks team  we'll fold the notes into the weekly KPI commentary. Closing unless anyone finds a blocker before Monday.
